title: Theo and the Regiment
author: W. M. Brightwater
blurb: Quentin Montrose, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
